preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be valid strings.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(sub) for sub in [S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]])
postconditions.description: The returned substring must be the longest palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min([S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1]], key=lambda x: S.index(x))
postconditions.description: In case of multiple longest palindromic substrings, the one with the least starting index must be returned.
